companyInfo.tagline_sw: Mtandao wa Kisasa wa Hotspot Billing & MikroTik Cloud nchini Tanzania
companyInfo.tagline_en: Next-Gen Hotspot Billing & MikroTik Cloud Platform in Tanzania
companyInfo.about_title_sw: Kuhusu Sisi & Mfumo Wetu wa Hotspot
companyInfo.about_description_sw:
INFOTECH WiFi ni mfumo bunifu na wa kisasa uliotengenezwa mahsusi kuwawezesha wamiliki wa Hotspot, migahawa, hoteli, vyuo, na wafanyabiashara wa intaneti nchini Tanzania kuuza na kudhibiti intaneti ya WiFi kwa njia rahisi ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, Halopesa) na vocha zilizochapishwa kupitia MikroTik, Ruijie, na TP-Link Omada.

Tunakupa uwezo wa kuunganisha router zako zote kwenye Cloud bila kuhitaji Static IP wala kusanidi VPN ngumu kwa mkono, huku ukikusanya mapato yako yote moja kwa moja kwenye namba yako ya simu au akaunti ya benki.
companyInfo.about_description_en:
INFOTECH WiFi is an innovative telecommunications and hotspot billing management platform empowering business owners, ISPs, cafes, hotels, and cyber cafes across Tanzania to automate mobile money billing (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, Halopesa) and print vouchers seamlessly with MikroTik, Ruijie, and TP-Link Omada routers.

We provide seamless Cloud VPN and FreeRADIUS connectivity for all your routers without requiring expensive static IPs, allowing you to monitor and monetize your network anywhere in Tanzania.
companyInfo.mission_sw: Kurahisisha uuzaji na usambazaji wa intaneti ya kasi ya juu kwa kila mfanyabiashara na mtumiaji nchini Tanzania kwa njia ya malipo ya kidijitali ya papo hapo bila usumbufu.
companyInfo.mission_en: To democratize and streamline high-speed internet delivery and monetization for businesses across Tanzania through effortless instant mobile money payments.
companyInfo.vision_sw: Kuwa jukwaa nambari moja na la kuaminika zaidi la Hotspot Billing na Usimamizi wa MikroTik katika ukanda mzima wa Afrika Mashariki.
companyInfo.vision_en: To be the leading, most reliable Hotspot Billing and MikroTik Cloud automation platform across East Africa.

services.title_sw: Malipo ya Papo kwa Papo (USSD Push)
services.description_sw: Wateja wanalipia kwa M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, na Halopesa ambapo simu inaleta pop-up ya PIN moja kwa moja chini ya sekunde 3.
services.description_en: Instant USSD payment push directly prompting customers for PIN on Vodacom, Tigo, Airtel, and Halotel within 3 seconds.

services.description_sw: Unganisha router nyingi (MikroTik, Ruijie, TP-Link) popote zilipo Tanzania kupitia FreeRADIUS na VPN bila Static IP.
services.description_en: Connect and remotely manage MikroTik and multi-brand router fleets across Tanzania via FreeRADIUS & Cloud VPN without public static IP.

services.description_sw: Tengeneza na chapisha kadi za vocha zenye QR Code kwa printa za kawaida (A4) au printa za risiti (Thermal POS 58mm/80mm).
services.description_en: Batch-generate and print beautiful branded voucher tickets with QR codes on standard A4 paper or POS thermal rolls.

services.description_sw: Dhibiti kasi ya kila kifurushi na mtumiaji ili kuzuia wateja wachache kumaliza intaneti na kutoa huduma thabiti.
services.description_en: Precise bandwidth control, queues, and fair-usage policies per user or ticket to ensure blazing speeds for all.

services.description_sw: Mfumo unazuia wateja kusambaza WiFi kwa simu au laptop nyingine kupitia Bluetooth au Hotspot tethering.
services.description_en: Automatic packet TTL control and firewall filters to prevent users from sharing hotspot via tethering.

services.description_sw: Wape wateja wapya intaneti ya majaribio ya dakika chache (mfano dakika 15) kwa kubonyeza kitufe kimoja tu.
services.description_en: Allow new visitors to claim automated free trial access for a designated duration to test the speed.

companyInfo.office_address_en: Kariakoo Business Tower, 4th Floor, Lumumba & Uhuru St, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania

companyInfo.support_note_sw: Tuko tayari kukuhudumia wakati wowote. Wasiliana nasi kwa simu, WhatsApp, au fika ofisini kwetu kwa msaada wa kusanidi router yako!
companyInfo.support_note_en: We are ready to assist you anytime. Contact us via phone, WhatsApp, or visit our office for router setup support!
